Pursuant to State and County Directives, the physical access to the meeting has been suspended. To
provide members of the public access to the meeting and an opportunity to comment on items on this the
Agenda, the following opportunity has been established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to CScommission@sgch.org and include the following on the subject line
of your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent, Public Hearing, Continued Business, New Business)
and Item Number you are commenting on. The Staff will read public comments into the record for up to
the three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and
discriminatory language, will not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A
Watch the Meeting Online

   City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  February 7, 2022

TO:  Community Services Commission

FROM:  Community Services Department Staff

BY:  Christina Alatorre, Recreation Supervisor

SUBJECT:  Monthly Department Report

Aquatics
Smith Park Pool continues normal winter operations with public lap swim and user group
pool use. Gabrielino High School has begun to train for their regular swim season. The
Public Works Department has done an excellent job in maintaining the pool throughout
the winter months.

Contract Classes
Classes for the Winter session began on January 3. Registration for the Spring Session
will start on March 1 with the first class taking place on March 28. We are thrilled to bring
back the Bi-Annual Dance show in June. It will take place outdoors at Vincent Lugo Park
similar in style to a concert in the park. We have amazing teachers within out department
that will ensure it is a spectacular event for the participants and viewers alike. More
information will be provided at the next meeting.

Facilities and Picnic Rentals
Staff are diligently accepting applications for the picnic shelters and the Adult Recreation
Center. We saw a small dip in inquires for the Adult Recreation Center due to concerns
surrounding the Omicron Variant. However, those concerns seem to be leveling out and
interest in booking has resumed. Staff are now booking events into 2023.

Kennedy Baseball Field has four current user groups renting the field for baseball
practices. In early January, Public Works led a group of volunteers in field improvements.
These improvements included leveling out the infield perimeter and adding additional
soil mix to the infield. The Public Works Department has worked diligently to maintain and
prepare the field for regular use.

  4-B
 Older Adult Programs and Trips
The senior meals program continues to take place on Tuesdays from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00
a.m. The Department is currently serving 162 seniors on a weekly basis. Staff continues to
do a great job serving the older adult population with their nutrition needs.

The trip to the BAPS Temple in Chino Hills was originally scheduled for February 5, but it
will now take place on March 26. The day will start with a tour of the Temple and the
surrounding grounds followed by lunch on site and ending with shopping at the Chino
Hills Shoppes. It is sure to be a beautiful day filled with cultural enlightenment. To submit
a trip idea or request please email Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor at
mmoralesstevens@sgch.org.

Youth Programs
After School Program - The after school programs continue at Coolidge, McKinley,
Washington and Wilson Elementary Schools. In January, staff have included enrichment
activities in their programming. Some activities included art and sports. Staff have done
an excellent job in engaging participants.

Jefferson Middle School Sports Clinics – The Co-ed Basketball Clinics at Jefferson
Middle School were put on pause January 10th – 28th due to an uptick in COVID-19 cases.
Since then the program has resumed, and has been extended to make up the weeks lost.
The Community Services Department continues to work alongside the San Gabriel School
District to ensure the safety and wellbeing of the participants and recreation staff.
Registration is now open for the second session, which runs February 14th – March 11th,
and is only open to Jefferson Middle School students.

Special Events
Lunar New Year - The 8th Annual Lunar New Year Virtual Celebration aired on the City
of San Gabriel’s YouTube Channel on Tuesday, February 1st at 6:00 p.m. This special video
celebration included New Year’s greetings from San Gabriel City Councilmembers, and
snippets of festive dances.

The Lunar New Year Family Game Night will be held virtually on Friday, February 11 from
6:30 p.m.-8:00 p.m. The game night includes Bingo, crafting, and building community. This
event is free, and registration is closed with a full capacity.
